tools.description: Create a new ML-DSA-87 identity in the configured empty encrypted vault.
tools.name: jacs_create_agent

tools.description: Sign a JSON object with the configured identity, preserving its algorithm. The signature records agent-key provenance, not human approval or proof that the content is true.
tools.name: jacs_sign_document

tools.description: Verify signed JSON integrity against an explicitly supplied public key and algorithm. Identity, trust, authorization, human approval, truth, freshness and revocation are not established.

public_key.description: Canonical standard-base64 raw public key, independently pinned by the caller

tools.name: jacs_verify_document

tools.description: Rotate to a new ML-DSA-87 key with an old-key-authorized transition proof, atomically replacing the configured vault.
tools.name: jacs_rotate_keys

tools.description: Re-encrypt the configured vault using the new password supplied by the host at startup. Passwords are never tool arguments.
tools.name: jacs_reencrypt_key

tools.description: Authenticate and import encrypted AgentMaterial into the configured empty vault; plaintext keys and overwrites are rejected.
tools.name: jacs_import_encrypted_agent

tools.description: Export authenticated encrypted AgentMaterial from the configured vault. Never exports plaintext key bytes.
tools.name: jacs_export_encrypted_agent
